subject: BUG: Fix off by one in StableGraph::node_bound
summary: `StableGraph::node_bound` used `rposition(...).unwrap_or(0) + 1`, which collapses to `1` on an empty graph and is off by one on dense graphs; the fix uses `next_back().map_or(0, |i| i.index() + 1)`.

subject: Fix bug in order of iterative dfs
summary: `Dfs::move_to` pre-visited the new start node while `next` dropped the pop-time `discovered.visit(node)` gate; reusing a Dfs via `move_to` after a full traversal re-emitted the already-discovered start node. The fix keeps the visit check at pop-time and no longer pre-visits.

Both proposed regions occur exactly once in their respective Git versions. No tests were executed.

subject: fix: Ford Fulkerson sometimes Panics on StableGraphs (#793)
summary: Ford-Fulkerson allocated its flow vector using edge_count() but indexed it by edge IDs. Removing edges from a StableGraph leaves gaps, so remaining edge IDs can exceed the vector bounds and cause a panic. Using edge_bound() allocates space for every valid edge index. The fix adds test_ford_fulkerson_stable_graphs in tests/ford_fulkerson.rs, gated by the default-enabled stable_graph feature. No tests were executed.

subject: fix: Infinite `subgraph_isomorphisms_iter` for empty isomorphisms (#780)
summary: For an empty pattern graph, subgraph_isomorphisms_iter repeatedly returns Some([]) because isomorphisms immediately returns the already-complete mapping without advancing state. The fix moves this case into GraphMatcher, whose iterator consumes the empty mapping once using Option::take and then returns None. The reversal restores the parent implementation of isomorphisms and GraphMatcher while preserving the regression test added in tests/iso.rs. No tests were executed.
